description: Triggers the Keycloak endpoint execute-actions-email for a user. This sends an email with one or more required actions the user must complete (for example resetting the password).

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: List of required actions to include in the email. Default: ["UPDATE_PASSWORD"]

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Optional client ID used for the redirect link.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID (UUID) of the user. Mutually exclusive with username.

parameters.name: lifespan
parameters.description: Optional lifespan (in seconds) for the action token (supported on newer Keycloak versions). Forwarded as query parameter if provided.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The Keycloak realm where the user resides. Default: "master"

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Optional redirect URI. Must be valid for the given client if client_id is set.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username of the user. Mutually exclusive with id.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Password reset email (default action) with 1h lifespan
  community.general.keycloak_user_execute_actions_email:
    username: johndoe
    realm: MyRealm
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: ADMIN
    auth_password: SECRET
    lifespan: 3600
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Multiple required actions using token auth
  community.general.keycloak_user_execute_actions_email:
    username: johndoe
    actions:
      - UPDATE_PASSWORD
      - VERIFY_EMAIL
    realm: MyRealm
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    token: TOKEN
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Email by user id with redirect
  community.general.keycloak_user_execute_actions_email:
    id: 9d59aa76-2755-48c6-b1af-beb70a82c3cd
    client_id: my-frontend
    redirect_uri: https://app.example.com/post-actions
    actions:
      - UPDATE_PASSWORD
    realm: MyRealm
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: ADMIN
    auth_password: SECRET
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: actions
return_values.description: List of actions included in the email. Returned: success

return_values.name: user_id
return_values.description: The user ID the email was (or would be, in check mode) sent to. Returned: success
